plain: A fix or remedy for a wrong; or to set a wrong right

more.text: Relief; remedy; deliverance from wrong, injury or oppression; as the redress of grievances.

example.quote: Congress shall make no law respecting an establishment of religion, or prohibiting the free exercise thereof; or abridging the freedom of speech, or of the press; or the right of the people peaceably to assemble, and to petition the Government for a redress of grievances.
